text: Based on the evidence from NASA FIRMS, there were no detected fires on the property in the two weeks before October 4, 2026. This is because no thermal anomalies were detected by any of the sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, MODIS) covering the asset during that period. However, it's important to note that small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may not have been detected.
